cycle: PATH discover forward/reverse without inventing reciprocal authority
RETRO compare predecessor and current descendant
CHALLENGE assumptions and run falsifiable bounded experiment
EVOLVE with one evidenced delta and preserve alternatives
VERIFY public source and independent receiver separately
HOLD unresolved, quiesce on duplicate/no material delta
media_rule: Future and high-value retrospective human-facing surfaces receive contextual hero/rich-media seed, with accessibility and text alternatives; no forced decoration.
audio_rule: START_SILENT; scroll-triggered sound without explicit opt-in prohibited. Visible mute and preference override; reduced-motion and sensory options honored.
next_proof: Have one independent authorized receiver read the entry, retrieve the media preview and report exact source and accessibility acceptance.
